title: Retro Game Tune Quiz
description: Listen to ten classic retro game tunes and name the game! Score points by recognizing Mario, Contra, Castlevania and more in this nostalgic music quiz.
controls: Tap Play the tune, then pick the right answer from four options. 10 points per correct tune.
author: LightGame
notes: Gameplay references classic game IP names and the bundled MP3s are unlicensed third-party music assets.
